prompt: Elements `[12, 3, 17, 8, 34, 40, 9]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[12, 3, 17, 8, 34, 40, 9]` to `[3, 8, 9, 12, 34, 40, 17]`.
